run_visualize_detections: run the script to visualize detection results from a detections.pkl file with configurable threshold
run_vis_with_limit: run the vis function to visualize only the first k images from a dataset
run_parse_args: run parse_args to get command line arguments for dataset, detections file, threshold, and output directory
run_vis_one_image: run vis_one_image to render bounding boxes, segmentations, and keypoints on a single image
run_load_detections: run the script to load a detections pickle file containing all_boxes, all_segms, and all_keyps
